title: From Curiosity to Caution: Mitigating Reward Hacking for Best-of-N with Pessimism
authors_zh: Zhuohao Yu, Zhiwei Steven Wu, Adam Block
paper_type_zh: 推理时奖励黑客缓解与不确定性选择
best_for_zh: 使用奖励模型做 Best-of-N 推理、需要控制过度优化和分布外选择的研究者。
one_line: Uses a learned uncertainty penalty to make Best-of-N reward selection pessimistic on atypical responses.
以典型回答上的预测误差估计不确定性，并在 Best-of-N 选择时惩罚可疑高分。
why: It turns uncertainty about atypical responses into an inference-time safeguard against reward-model exploitation.
inclusion_reason: Mitigates reward hacking from reward-model over-optimization in Best-of-N selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Best-of-N sampling generates many candidates, lets a reward model score them, and returns the maximum. As N grows, this can select atypical responses that exploit reward-model shortcuts rather than improve true quality, producing the characteristic rise then fall in accuracy. Stronger rewards are incomplete protection, whereas global distribution constraints can reject genuinely good novel answers.

The paper proposes an inference-time pessimism mechanism, called caution. It estimates whether each reward score is unreliable because its response is atypical, subtracts that uncertainty from the score, and tests whether larger sampling budgets can again help rather than amplify reward hacking.

The intended safety check is therefore true task quality at increasing N, not reward score alone.

Best-of-N 会生成多个候选、由奖励模型打分并返回最高分，但 N 增大时可能选中利用奖励模型捷径的非典型回答，而非真实质量更高的回答，准确率便先升后降。仅增强奖励模型无法穷尽所有投机方式，而强制整体分布贴近生成器又可能拒绝真正更好的新回答。

论文提出名为 caution 的推理时悲观机制。它判断某个奖励分是否因回答非典型而不可靠，从分数中扣除不确定性，并检验更大采样预算能否重新带来收益，而非放大奖励黑客。

因此，安全检查应观察 N 增大时的真实任务质量，而不能只看奖励分数是否持续升高。候选越多带来的分布尾部探索，正是普通选择容易失真的位置。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Caution reverses curiosity-driven exploration: a lightweight predictor learns, on typical prompt–response pairs, to reconstruct a frozen reward model’s hidden features; large reconstruction error becomes an OOD uncertainty penalty rather than a novelty bonus. Best-of-N selects by reward minus λ times that error. The approach uses prompts and sampled responses rather than new human labels, and the paper provides official supplementary materials but no independently verified code repository.

The penalty is reward-aware because its target is internal reward-model representation, not a random feature alone.

caution 将好奇心驱动探索反转：轻量预测器在典型问题—回答对上学习重构冻结奖励模型的隐藏表征，大的重构误差不再作为新颖性奖励，而是作为分布外不确定性惩罚。Best-of-N 按“奖励减去 λ 倍误差”选择。方法只利用提示和采样回答，不需要新增人工标签；论文提供官方补充材料，但未核验到独立代码仓库。

惩罚之所以与奖励相关，是因为其目标是奖励模型内部表征，而不是单纯随机特征；它希望只降低奖励模型本身不可靠区域的分数。λ 控制惩罚强度，过大时也可能牺牲奖励模型已能正确识别的高质量回答。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample typical responses from the generator for prompts in a training distribution.
  2. Freeze a reward model and extract its layer-L hidden representation as a target feature.
  3. Train a lightweight predictor to reconstruct that feature with mean-squared error; prediction error is the uncertainty signal.
  4. For each test prompt, generate N candidates and compute reward, target features, and predictor error in parallel.
  5. Form a pessimistic reward r-hat minus λ times error, then return the highest-scoring candidate; λ=0 is ordinary Best-of-N.
  6. Evaluate peak, final-at-N=512, and degradation accuracy across GSM8K, MATH-500, and BigBench-Hard. Prompt distributions, generator, reward models, λ, and sampling budget must be fixed; code is not independently verified.

The selection check is true-answer accuracy on held-out tasks as N scales, not only the modified reward value.

1. 从训练分布中的提示出发，由生成器采样典型回答。
  2. 冻结奖励模型，取其第 L 层隐藏表征作为目标特征。
  3. 用均方误差训练轻量预测器重构该特征，预测误差即不确定性信号。
  4. 测试时每题生成 N 个候选，并行计算奖励、目标特征和预测误差。
  5. 构造“奖励减 λ 倍误差”的悲观分数，取最高者；λ=0 即普通 Best-of-N。
  6. 在 GSM8K、MATH-500、BigBench-Hard 上报告峰值、N=512 最终准确率和退化量。复现须固定提示分布、生成器、奖励模型、λ 与预算；代码未独立核验。

选择检查应是留出任务上的真实答案准确率随 N 如何变化，而非修改后的奖励值本身。预测器离线训练，避免在线持续更新的时间和内存开销；若奖励模型层或目标提示改变，应重新训练并校准误差尺度。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — per-response pessimism can prevent accuracy collapse as Best-of-N budget grows.

Setup — Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct generated solutions; the caution predictor was trained on GSM8K prompts and tested with N up to 512 on GSM8K, MATH-500, and BigBench-Hard. Results compare standard reward selection, pessimism only, and their combination.

Result — on GSM8K, reward-only selection peaked at 79.3% but fell to 71.5% at N=512 (7.7-point degradation); reward plus caution reached 82.6% peak and 81.1% final (1.5 points). On BigBench-Hard, reward-only final accuracy was 1.7%, whereas the combined method reached 11.0%; pessimism-only was 22.1%.

Boundary — the result uses exact-answer reasoning tasks and a predictor trained from benchmark prompts; it does not prove the same penalty preserves subjective preference quality or every reward model.

Confidence intervals use three bootstrap runs, and the mixed result on BigBench-Hard shows that pessimism-only can dominate the combination under severe domain shift.

主张——逐回答的悲观扣分可避免 Best-of-N 预算增大时准确率崩塌。

设置——Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 生成解答；预测器只在 GSM8K 提示上训练，N 最大为 512，并在 GSM8K、MATH-500、BigBench-Hard 比较普通奖励选择、仅悲观和二者结合。

结果——GSM8K 上普通奖励选择峰值 79.3%，N=512 降至 71.5%，退化 7.7 点；结合 caution 的峰值为 82.6%、最终 81.1%，退化 1.5 点。BigBench-Hard 上普通奖励最终仅 1.7%，结合方法为 11.0%，仅悲观为 22.1%。

边界——实验基于有精确答案的推理任务和基准提示训练的预测器，不能证明同一惩罚会保留主观偏好质量或适用于所有奖励模型。

表中均值附带三次 bootstrap 的 95% 置信区间；BigBench-Hard 上仅悲观优于结合项，说明严重跨域时原奖励仍可能拖累组合。该比较支持缓解过度优化，而不是保证每个 N、每个领域都由混合分数最优。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier mitigation either tries to make the reward model universally stronger or constrains the entire selected distribution near the base generator. Caution instead changes the selection score locally: it penalizes each response according to error in predicting reward-model representations, allowing slightly atypical candidates when their uncertainty is low. It adapts RND-style prediction error from an exploration bonus to an offline caution penalty. The novelty is this reward-aware, per-response pessimism, not merely using OOD detection or lower confidence bounds.

Its practical distinction is that the predictor is trained offline and adds only parallel forward computations at selection time.

已有缓解要么试图让奖励模型普遍更强，要么把整个被选分布限制在接近生成器的位置。caution 改变的是局部选择分数：按预测奖励模型表征的误差惩罚每个回答，因此不确定性低的轻微分布外候选仍可被选中。它把 RND 式预测误差从探索奖励改成离线的谨慎惩罚。真正新意是这种与奖励表征相连、逐回答执行的悲观机制，而非泛泛采用 OOD 检测或下置信界。

实践上的差异还在于预测器完全离线训练，选择时只增加可并行的前向计算，不需要在线探索中的持续更新。它保留了 Best-of-N 的候选生成机制，只改变最终排序依据，因而可接入已有推理管线。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Caution assumes predictor error on frozen reward features tracks uncertainty about true reward; an atypical but genuinely excellent response can still be penalized. The method needs representative prompts and sampled responses to train the predictor, and its λ trades off exploitation against conservatism. Reported evidence centers on mathematical and reasoning benchmarks with exact-answer rewards; subjective, multilingual, or adversarial preferences may behave differently. The theory is explicitly a simplified linear setting, so it does not establish general neural-network guarantees.

Before deployment, compare reward-only, caution-only, and combined curves instead of assuming a fixed mixture is best.

caution 假定冻结奖励表征上的预测误差能够反映真实奖励的不确定性，因此非典型但确实优秀的回答仍可能被错罚。方法需要有代表性的提示和采样回答训练预测器，λ 也在利用与保守之间取舍。证据集中于有精确答案的数学与推理基准；主观偏好、多语言或对抗场景可能不同。理论明确只在简化线性设定成立，不能提供一般神经网络保证。

部署前应同时比较仅奖励、仅悲观和混合曲线，不能假定固定混合必然最佳。若训练提示与目标流量差异过大，预测误差可能只检测到主题变化，而非真正会导致奖励黑客的异常模式。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
A team already using a reward model for Best-of-N can train a predictor on typical prompt–response samples, then deploy reward minus uncertainty and monitor peak-to-final degradation as N rises. A reasoning benchmark owner can test whether an apparent scaling gain is reward hacking by plotting true accuracy against N under reward-only and cautious selection. Do not use the method as a substitute for reward-model validation when no representative prompt distribution or independent quality check exists; tune λ on held-out conditions and retain a reward-only baseline.

The required output is a calibrated selection policy plus a chart of true quality, uncertainty, and cost across candidate budgets.

已用奖励模型做 Best-of-N 的团队，可在典型问题—回答样本上训练预测器，再部署“奖励减不确定性”，并监控 N 增大时峰值到最终的退化量。推理基准维护者可绘制真实准确率随 N 的曲线，比较普通与悲观选择，以判断表面扩展收益是否是奖励黑客。若没有代表性提示分布或独立质量检查，不应把它当成奖励模型验证的替代；应在留出条件上调 λ 并保留普通基线。

应交付经校准的选择策略，以及真实质量、不确定性和计算成本随候选预算变化的曲线。对主观写作任务还应另设人工偏好抽检，确认惩罚没有系统性压低新颖、少数风格或长尾表达。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: caution is an inference-time safeguard for reward-model Best-of-N, not reward-model retraining.
  2. Method handle: reconstruct frozen reward features on typical outputs; use reconstruction error as a negative uncertainty penalty.
  3. Artifact handle: official supplementary materials are linked; no independent code repository was verified.
  4. Evidence anchor: GSM8K reward-only degrades 79.3→71.5 at N=512, while combined caution is 82.6→81.1.
  5. Reuse decision: useful when more samples cause true quality to fall; first validate λ and OOD behavior on held-out target tasks.

A successful use keeps improvement monotonic or nearly so while making the additional forward-pass cost explicit.

Record the chosen layer and λ because both determine which responses are treated as uncertain.\n

1. 定位：caution 是奖励模型 Best-of-N 的推理时防护，不是重训奖励模型。
  2. 方法：在典型输出上重构冻结奖励表征，把重构误差作为负向不确定性惩罚。
  3. 产物：官方补充材料已链接；未独立核验到代码仓库。
  4. 证据：GSM8K 普通选择在 N=512 从 79.3 降到 71.5，结合方法从 82.6 到 81.1。
  5. 决策：适合样本变多反而降低真实质量时；复用前应在留出任务验证 λ 和分布外行为。

成功复用应让质量随预算保持单调或近似单调提升，并明确额外前向计算成本。若惩罚主要识别格式而非质量风险，需检查其是否对少数表达方式造成不公平的系统性扣分。

还应记录所选奖励层和 λ，因为二者共同决定哪些回答会被视为不确定。\n
